'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Kristoffer Basse Hedlund LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kristoffer Basse Hedlund]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Kristoffer Basse Hedlund]]

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
